name: datepicker
description: Asks someone for a date. A native date input, so every platform's own picker, keyboard handling, and screen reader support come for free. To show a month rather than ask for a day, use calendar.

label.description: What the date is for: 'Due date', not 'Date'.

name.description: Form field name. Also the default id.

value.description: The date already chosen, as YYYY-MM-DD.

min.title: Earliest allowed
min.description: As YYYY-MM-DD. The browser refuses earlier dates.

hint.description: Help text under the label. Say the format if it matters.

error.description: Validation message. Sets aria-invalid and is linked with aria-describedby.

keyboard.does: moves focus to and from the field, and between its day, month and year parts
changes the part under the cursor

wcag.notes: A native date input rather than a built calendar widget, so the keyboard model, the picker, and the announcements are the platform's own and work in every assistive technology without our code. The date can always be typed, so nobody has to use the picker. Label always visible; min and max are enforced by the browser and stated in the hint when they matter.

machine.identify: The accessible name is the label text. The value is an ISO date, YYYY-MM-DD.
machine.operate: Set the input's value to an ISO date. No need to open the picker.

props.label: Start
props.name: start
props.hint: Nothing earlier than the first of the month.

props.label: Deadline
props.name: deadline
props.error: Pick a date in the future.
